title: Level 3 (Advanced) - B-8
notes:
West leads the ♥J against 4♠. South should play low from dummy at trick 1. West is unlikely to have led from a King in a suit bid by South. However, South can always lead towards the ♥Q later if necessary.

East produces the ♥K, an obvious singleton. If South wins the ♥A, he will go down when West has the ♠A. South can lead a trump, but West will win. West will lead high hearts through North's ♥Q. Whenever the ♥Q is played East will ruff. South will lose 2 heart tricks in addition to the 2 tricks that already have been lost.

South should allow East to win the first trick with his ♥K. South can win any return and play a spade. West can win and return a heart. A low card is played from dummy. If East ruffs, he is ruffing a trick his partner would eventually have taken. South will be able to win any return, draw the remaining trump, and take the rest of the tricks.
